description: `case pattern if condition:`: evaluated after the pattern matched and bound its names; if false, matching continues with the next case.
`p1 | p2`: tries the alternatives left to right. Every alternative must bind the same names.
`pattern as name`: binds the value that the pattern on the left matched, for example which alternative of an or-pattern.
A dotted name such as `Role.ADMIN`, looked up when the case runs and compared with `==`.
A bare name such as `ADMIN`: matches anything and binds it. It never compares with an existing variable.
